title: Sphere emoji in Divine Essence section should use sphere-colored icons
description: The Divine Essence section uses Unicode emoji (⚡🪨🔥🌿🧠👻⏳🌀) to represent creation spheres. Per STYLE.md, these should be replaced with dedicated sphere-colored SVG/CSS icons following the sphere form language system.
evidence: 12 emoji instances found in SPAN.text-sm elements in Divine Essence sections
location: Divine Essence section (creation screen + main game sidebar)
suggestedFix: Replace emoji with CSS-based sphere icons using sphere-specific colors from STYLE.md. Each should have distinct visual form per sphere form language.

title: Rival Gods uses generic emoji instead of dedicated icons
description: The Rival Gods section uses generic emoji (🌊⚔️🏰) instead of unique visual identities tied to each rival god's sphere affinities.
evidence: Three emoji instances in Rival Gods panel: 🌊, ⚔️, 🏰
suggestedFix: Create custom icons per rival god reflecting their sphere affinities, using Threadbare color palette and sphere form language.

title: UI chrome brightness slightly above STYLE.md spec threshold
description: STYLE.md specifies UI chrome at oklch(0.21-0.24). Some chrome elements measure at oklch(0.374), exceeding the upper threshold.
evidence: Dark panels oklch(0.268) slightly above, lighter chrome oklch(0.374) well above spec
suggestedFix: Adjust oklch L component for lighter chrome elements from 0.374 down to max 0.24.

title: Sphere indicator colors below STYLE.md magic brightness range (70-100%)
description: Sphere indicators use 5-47% brightness. STYLE.md specifies magic elements at 70-100% brightness for concentrated threadlike appearance.
location: Creation Spheres sliders and Divine Essence labels
suggestedFix: Shift sphere indicator colors to 70-100% brightness: Force→#ff6666, Time→#ffaa33, Mind→#dd66ff.

title: Avatar label appears 3 times across left sidebar and center HUD
description: The word 'Avatar' appears at 3 positions simultaneously: sidebar header, center HUD button (×2). The sidebar already anchors player identity.
suggestedFix: Rename center HUD 'Avatar' button to 'Move' or remove redundant label; sidebar divine name is sufficient.

title: Mandate name appears 13 times in redundant DOM nesting
description: The mandate name 'Threads of Fate' appears 13 times across nested DOM elements — likely due to overlapping container rendering. Should appear once in top bar, once in narrative feed.
evidence: 13 occurrences at overlapping coordinates (824,8), (840,16), etc.
suggestedFix: Refactor mandate tracker DOM to eliminate nested text duplication. Only 1-2 visible instances needed.

title: Extreme density imbalance: center 1024 words vs left sidebar 90 words
description: Center zone (mostly hex grid) contains 1024 words while the critical control panel (left sidebar) has only 90. Narrative feed in bottom has 102 words.
evidence: LEFT={52 nodes, 90 words}, CENTER={178 nodes, 1024 words}, BOTTOM={16 nodes, 102 words}
suggestedFix: Expand left sidebar with more descriptive labels. Consider moving some narrative context to dedicated panel.

title: Mandate progression logged 3× in narrative feed plus status badge
description: Players see mandate completion 16+ times: 13× DOM nesting + 3 narrative entries (escalation/culmination/fulfilled). Only the final 'Victory!' is meaningful in the feed.
evidence: Tick 1: escalation, Tick 2: culmination, Tick 3: fulfilled — plus top bar badge + 13 DOM instances
suggestedFix: Log only final 'Victory!' in narrative feed. Use top-bar tracker for real-time progression. Remove intermediate state changes from feed.

title: 6 identical essence values (2.2) displayed with no visual hierarchy
description: Six of eight sphere values show identical '2.2' in the Divine Essence grid. No visual distinction between primary, secondary, and neutral spheres.
evidence: '2.2' appears 6 times at (246,469-599) in same column, font, color
suggestedFix: Add context labels ('primary'/'neutral') or use a bar chart. Consider collapsing identical low values.

title: 15 identical 'mutual trust' entries in narrative feed with no prose variation
description: Narrative feed contains 15 entries of '[A] and [B]: mutual trust' — all identical phrasing. No adjectives, no variation, no narrative richness.
evidence: 15 entries across ticks 1-25, all using identical format
suggestedFix: Vary relationship prose: 'bond deepens', 'alliance forms', 'recognizes trust'. Consult narrative engine for tone-appropriate templates.

title: Rival god actions repeat exact wording across ticks
description: 'The Bone Tyrant extends their reach into new territory' appears at ticks 5 and 27 (exact duplicate). Only 2-3 templates per god visible in 33-tick window.
evidence: Exact duplicate at ticks 5 and 27
suggestedFix: Verify rival-content.ts RIVAL_ACTION_TEMPLATES has 3-4+ variants per action type. Check PRNG template selection in orchestrator.

title: Right sidebar empty when no agent selected (8 words total)
description: Right sidebar shows only 'No agents under your influence yet.' — large dead zone. Could surface mandate details, rival profiles, or sphere breakdown.
evidence: 8 words in ~300×800px sidebar area
suggestedFix: Show default content: expanded mandate view, rival profiles with hostility meters, or sphere influence breakdown.

title: Top bar treats doom, mandate, and debug with equal visual weight
description: Doom clock (game-end timer), mandate tracker, and Debug button are equally prominent in the top bar. Doom should be most prominent.
evidence: All elements in single horizontal bar with no size/color differentiation
suggestedFix: Use color/size hierarchy: doom in red/orange (left, prominent), mandate in gold (center, smaller), debug in gray (right, tucked away).

title: Left sidebar has 4 H2 headings but no H3 subheadings
description: All sidebar sections (Time, Divine Essence, Rival Gods) are H2 siblings. No H3 subheadings for sub-sections.
evidence: [H1: title], [H2: Time], [H2: Divine Essence], [H2: Rival Gods]. No H3 tags.
suggestedFix: Add H3 subheadings: H2 'Divine Essence' → H3 'Sphere Pools'. H2 'Rival Gods' → H3 'Hostility'.

title: Avatar button toggle state doesn't visibly change the sidebar
description: Avatar button can be toggled active/inactive, but sidebar remains unchanged. Unclear what 'active' state represents to the user.
evidence: Avatar button toggles but sidebar shows 'No agents under your influence yet' regardless
suggestedFix: Show avatar detail panel in sidebar when Avatar is clicked, or remove active state and make it informational only.

title: Excessive prop drilling through GameView to ScryOverlay
description: ScryOverlay receives 9+ props passed from GameView through hooks. Context API would reduce this coupling.
evidence: GameView.tsx: ScryOverlay receives scryState, retinueAgents, essencePool, primarySphere, tick, seed, onAssign, onDemote, onClose
suggestedFix: Create ScryContext to hold scryState, handlers, and dependencies. Wrap with provider at GameView level.

title: Hardcoded color strings duplicated across 5+ components
description: Colors like '#d4a574', '#a78bfa', '#eab308' are independently defined in StrandView, DebugPanel, MandateTracker, DoomBar. No single source of truth.
evidence: 4+ separate color maps: STRAND_COLORS, CATEGORY_BADGE_COLORS, ARCHETYPE_COLORS, TYPE_COLORS
suggestedFix: Create src/data/uiColorPalette.ts with shared color constants. Import across all components.

title: ScryOverlay creates inline closures in map callbacks without memoization
description: PositionSlot and ContextMenu rendered inline inside map callbacks create new function references every render. With 10+ slots, causes unnecessary re-renders.
evidence:
ScryOverlay.tsx: apexPositions.map(pos => (
))
suggestedFix: Extract PositionSlotWithMenu as a memoized component. Use React.memo on inner components.

title: Type casting to 'any' in ScryOverlay inner components
description: PositionSlot and AgentPickerPanel accept 'position: any' rather than proper Position type.
evidence: ScryOverlay.tsx: function PositionSlot({ position }: { position: any; ... })
suggestedFix: Import Position type from types/scry and replace 'any' with proper types.

title: StrandView renderContent() not memoized — 6 branches evaluated every render
description: renderContent() returns large JSX conditionally without useMemo. activeStrand state change triggers full re-render.
evidence: StrandView.tsx: renderContent() function (186 lines) runs 6 switch branches every render, no useMemo
suggestedFix: Wrap in useMemo(() => renderContent(), [activeStrand]) or extract 6 separate memoized strand components.

title: SVG elements with click handlers missing ARIA labels and keyboard support
description: HexZoomView location circles and text respond to click/doubleClick but lack role='button', aria-label, or onKeyDown.
evidence: HexZoomView.tsx: <circle> and <text> elements have onClick but no ARIA attributes
suggestedFix: Wrap in <g role='button' aria-label='{loc.name}' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={...}>.

title: DebugPanel and overlay close buttons lack descriptive aria-labels
description: Close buttons use '✕' text with no aria-label. Screen readers can't identify button purpose.
evidence: DebugPanel.tsx, ScryOverlay.tsx, StrandView.tsx: <button> ✕ </button> without aria-label
suggestedFix: Add aria-label='Close [panel name]' and title='Close (Esc)' to all close buttons.

title: Hex size calculations repeated inline across HexMap and HexTile
description: HexMap computes 1.5*size, √3*size inline. HexTile recomputes imgSize = size*2. No shared hex math utility.
evidence: HexMap.tsx: cols * hexSize * 1.5 + hexSize * 0.5; HexTile.tsx: size * 2
suggestedFix: Add HEX_SCALE_X = 1.5, HEX_SCALE_Y = Math.sqrt(3) to lib/hexMath.ts. Import consistently.

title: MandateTracker and DoomBar duplicate progress bar implementation
description: Both components implement identical progress bars (h-2 rounded-full, boxShadow glow). Code duplication.
evidence: MandateTracker.tsx and DoomBar.tsx both have identical progress bar CSS
suggestedFix: Extract shared ProgressBar component: <ProgressBar progress={0.65} color='#d4a574' glow={true} />.

title: AgentWheel hardcoded glyph emoji map not data-driven
description: SLOT_GLYPHS uses hardcoded emoji (👁💭🗣 etc.) directly in component. Should be in data layer.
evidence: AgentWheel.tsx: const SLOT_GLYPHS: Record<string, string> = { scry: '👁', dream: '💭', ... }
suggestedFix: Move SLOT_GLYPHS to src/data/uiAssets.ts. Import at module level.
